assets/alexscaves/lang/en_us.json.enchantment.alexscaves.flinging.desc: Ortholance launch moves the player much further

contract.charge: C=clamp(72000-useTime,0,60); only C>0 changes requested velocity
contract.server_gate: C>=10 and !isClientSide gate waves, wear and AABB hit iteration; final movement has no local side gate
contract.cost: one hurtAndBreakUsedHand(stack,1,actor) request in server C>=10 branch; no separate Flinging debit
contract.geometry: B=C/5 integer normal; B=5 with Tsunami; AABB(P,P+V9*B).inflate(1D), before final vertical bonus
contract.target: LivingEntity candidates; reject actor-allied, self and failed hasLineOfSight; hurt return discarded; stopRiding follows
contract.damage: mobAttack(actor), float attackDamageBonus(stack); F has no independent damage coefficient
contract.waves: normal 2*B spawn requests; Second Wave adds 2*max(1,B-1) delayed requests only in normal branch; Tsunami one and skips Second Wave; addFreshEntity return discarded
contract.persistence: Wave stores Owner UUID and Lifespan; waiting/scale/yaw/slam and activeWaveTicks not saved by own NBT overrides
contract.ownership: Wave owner reference+UUID; getOwner server lookup resolves only LivingEntity; tick/attackEntities use raw owner with no getOwner call; not guaranteed postreload recovery or credit/dedup receipt
contract.cooldown: getUseDuration=72000; no dedicated Flinging cooldown set in complete item bodies; external lifecycle unverified
